notes.title: Furniture Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41122883/3b12354319095e4b6e55c03180cce76dd25499f7.png[/img]
This update adds the ability to create your own interior, as well as various other improvements:
[list]
[*] Customization of the interior in your home!
[*] Added a new type of slimes
[*] Achievements added!
[*] The change of day and night now occurs correctly
[*] Many smaller fixes!
[/list]

notes.title: Added tutorial
